status: draft — issue #509, epic #507; split by issue #518 (ADR-0039); read by scripts/contracts/contract.sh and the module's command. Format: docs/records/design-reviews/io-contract-modules.md > 5.
goal: For each pull request it is given, CI green on the head — or, where no CI runs for it, that fact and its ground recorded on it — with the body's CI part stating that result and the CI job that ran each test file the change added.

timeout.note: the run's bound in seconds; not given, 900. Reaching it ends the run with its failure output

pull_requests.note: the pull requests to confirm: the list at .pull_requests, each {pr: <owner>/<name>#<N>, head}

build_report.note: the test files the change added (## Test files kept) and the ci-deferred lint chains

ci.note: {prs: [{pr, head, verdict, exit, observed, failing: [{name, url}]}]} — verdict green, not-run, failed, conflict, pending or unread, by confirm-ci-green.sh's exit (0, 11, 12, 10, 13, 14); observed its last stderr line

checks.note: each green or not-run, judged again by confirm-ci-green.sh --once on the head the entry names; the entries' {pr, head} exactly the input's

failure.note: Written instead of the expected output when the run cannot reach it, or reaches its timeout: what the run did, what it observed, and why it did not reach the expected output — an input it needed and was not given named as such. check-out then writes `failed` (docs/units/delivery.md > What every delivery module owes).
